harness_notes: Same harness as cleanup: each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]`, the seed ends with a 'Live state' section standing in for the session's environment and its current title, only the Skill tool is available, and every command or tool call is logged as a fenced ```json {"action", "args"} block. Any rename or title action counts as a rename, whether it runs the helper script or a session tool; the harness says the desktop app's session tools exist, so the skill is expected to use one. `prompt` runs with the plugin loaded, `baseline_prompt` without it.

evals.baseline_prompt: Rename this session after what it was actually about.
evals.expected_output: Renames the session once, to a 2 to 5 word sentence-case title, never ALL CAPS, that names where the session ended up, the CI matrix migration, and not the flaky test it opened on. Confirms the new name in one line, says the pane header may show the old title until the session is reopened, and doesn't rename a second time.
expectations: The title is 2 to 5 words, not all caps, with no dash and no session, chat or work
The title names the destination (the CI matrix), not the origin (the flaky test)
Confirms the new name in one line

evals.baseline_prompt: Rename this session: checkout retry bug
evals.expected_output: Uses the topic the user passed as the title, without putting it in ALL CAPS: Checkout retry bug. It doesn't name the session after the webhook work that takes up most of the transcript.
expectations: The title is 'checkout retry bug' in any capitalisation except ALL CAPS
